== Usage ==
A concise changelog for this article's subject — write the table body
directly as normal wikitable syntax; this template just wraps it in a
styled, labelled panel.

<pre>
{{Patch history|
! Update !! Date !! Change
|-
| [[Trailblazers]] || 2025-04-30 || Colonisation economy significantly reworked (Update 3).
}}
</pre>

Place near the bottom of an article, in the same position as
{{tl|Engineering nav}} or other footer-level templates. Link the Update
name to its own article where one exists — see [[:Category:Updates]] and
[[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Updating Game Statistics]]. Linking the
Update name is also what lets <code>Special:WhatLinksHere</code> on that
Update's own page answer "which articles were affected by this update,"
with no separate per-update category needed.
[[Category:Templates]]
</noinclude>
